name: Diamond Point
description: Blocks cut as low four-sided pyramids like the Palazzo dei Diamanti, lit from above, with broad patches sunk where the rest stand proud.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --turn: @calc(round(@rn(0, 1, 2)) * 180)deg; background: conic-gradient(from 225deg at 50% 50%, var(--color2) 0 90deg, transparent 90deg), @p(var(--color3)); -webkit-clip-path: inset(3%); clip-path: inset(3%); transform: rotate(@var(--turn)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0% 0%, 100% 0%, 50% 50%); clip-path: polygon(0% 0%, 100% 0%, 50% 50%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0% 100%, 100% 100%, 50% 50%); clip-path: polygon(0% 100%, 100% 100%, 50% 50%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
